visual.observation: A registration interface on forsage.io displays a step titled "BUSD Authorization" and asks the user to press "Confirm"; it states that a BUSD transaction requires BNB to pay network fees.
visual.context: The screen appears to show a wallet-connected registration flow, but the purpose and surrounding narration are not visible.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface links an authorization/confirmation action to a BUSD transaction and a required BNB fee, which conditionally merits review as a financial-action request.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether any transaction was submitted, whether funds moved, who would receive them, or whether the interface is genuine.

visual.observation: The registration flow states that sending BUSD for registration will pay a network commission to Forsage and that sending BUSD directly to the contract without prior approval will cause an error and the transaction will not go through; a "To register" button is shown.
visual.context: This is presented as an on-screen registration instruction associated with the Forsage-branded interface.
visual.potential_relevance: The screen connects account registration with sending BUSD and paying a commission under a stated transaction condition, which conditionally merits review as a cryptocurrency payment instruction.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not show the transaction destination, amount, authorization result, or any later outcome.

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled sequence visibly moves from a cryptocurrency wallet view to the forsage.io site and then to a registration interface with wallet and network selections.
